info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Product Inventory Item Management API
info.description: This API enables businesses to manage product inventory items effectively within a banking channel context. It allows for the addition of new inventory items, ensuring that product availability is consistently updated and accurately reflected in the system. Typical consumers include inventory managers and application developers looking to integrate product management capabilities into their banking applications. The API facilitates operations that enhance inventory accuracy and streamline product-related workflows.

post.summary: Create a new channel-specific product inventory item.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to create a new product inventory item that is specific to a particular sales channel. Ensure that all required fields are populated according to the business rules for product inventory management.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to manage product inventory items specific to a channel. It allows for the creation or update of inventory details including item specifications and quantities.

201.description: Resource created successfully. Returns the newly created item.
